ei.title: Practice 02 — 전시회 부스 설치 작업 지연을 해결하기 위한 즉각적인 대책 요구
ei.subject: 올림포스독해의기본2

fullPassage: My brother, Daniel Jones, recommended your company as one that would do a good job of building our exhibition booths, but we have seen virtually no progress on the project during recent weeks. Our conference is scheduled for March 3. With our advance payment, you agreed to have the work completed one week prior to the opening (contract copy enclosed). I question whether you will be able to meet the terms of the contract, and I am very concerned about being ready for the conference. Please call me, and follow up in writing, about how you intend to complete the work on time. If it appears that you will default on this contract, we will take immediate measure to protect ourselves.

questions.passage: My brother, Daniel Jones, ①<u>recommended</u> your company as one that would do a good job of building our exhibition booths, but we have seen virtually no progress on the project during recent weeks. Our conference is scheduled for March 3. With our advance payment, you agreed to have the work ②<u>completing</u> one week prior to the opening (contract copy enclosed). I question whether you will be able to meet the terms of the contract, and I am very ③<u>concerned</u> about being ready for the conference. Please call me, and follow up in writing, about how you intend to complete the work on time. If it appears that you will default on this contract, we will take ④<u>immediate</u> measure to protect ourselves.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② recommended=추천했다, ② completed→completing 오류(have the work + p.p. 구문), ③ concerned=걱정하는, ④ immediate=즉각적인
det.analysis:
❌ ① recommended: 과거 타동사로 적절
✅ ② completing: 원문은 completed. 'have + 목적어 + p.p.'에서 work는 complete되는 수동 대상이므로 completed가 맞음. completing(능동/진행)은 오류 ←정답
❌ ③ concerned: be concerned about 형태로 적절
❌ ④ immediate: 명사 measure를 수식하는 형용사로 적절
det.tip: have + 목적어 + done(수동) vs have + 목적어 + doing(능동) — work는 완성되는 대상 → completed 필수

questions.passage: My brother, Daniel Jones, recommended your company as ①<u>one</u> that would do a good job of building our exhibition booths, but we have seen virtually no progress on the project during recent weeks. Our conference is ②<u>scheduled</u> for March 3. With our advance payment, you agreed to have the work completed one week prior to the opening (contract copy enclosed). I question ③<u>that</u> you will be able to meet the terms of the contract, and I am very concerned about being ready for the conference. Please call me, and follow up in writing, about how you intend to complete the work on time. If it appears that you will default on this contract, we will take ④<u>immediate</u> measure to protect ourselves.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ one=부정대명사, ② scheduled=예정된, ③ whether→that 오류(question의 목적어), ④ immediate=즉각적인
det.analysis:
❌ ① one: as one that would do a good job — 부정대명사로 적절
❌ ② scheduled: be scheduled for — 수동태로 적절
✅ ③ that: 원문은 whether. 'I question whether...'는 '~인지 의문이다'로 의문/불확실을 나타내는 whether가 맞음. that은 확실한 사실절에 쓰임 ←정답
❌ ④ immediate: 형용사로 measure 수식, 적절
det.tip: question + whether: 불확실/의심 / question + that: 어법상 자연스럽지 않음

questions.passage: My brother, Daniel Jones, recommended your company as one that would do a good job of building our exhibition ①<u>booths</u>, but we have seen virtually no progress on the project during recent weeks. Our conference is scheduled for March 3. With our advance payment, you ②<u>agreed</u> to have the work completed one week ③<u>prior</u> to the opening (contract copy enclosed). I question whether you will be able to meet the terms of the contract, and I am very concerned about being ready for the conference. Please call me, and follow up in writing, about how you intend to complete the work on time. If it appears that you will default on this contract, we will take immediate measure to protect ④<u>us</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ booths=부스들(복수), ② agreed=동의했다, ③ prior=이전의, ④ ourselves→us 오류(재귀대명사 필요)
det.analysis:
❌ ① booths: 복수 명사 적절
❌ ② agreed: 과거 동사 적절
❌ ③ prior: prior to = ~에 앞서, 전치사구로 적절
✅ ④ us: 원문은 ourselves. 주어(we)와 목적어가 같은 대상이므로 재귀대명사 ourselves가 필요. us로 쓰면 '남이 우리를 보호'하는 의미가 됨 ←정답
det.tip: 주어와 목적어가 동일 대상 → 재귀대명사(ourselves). we protect us(×) → we protect ourselves(○)

questions.passage: My brother, Daniel Jones, recommended your company as one that would do a good job of building our exhibition booths, but we have seen ①<u>virtually</u> no progress on the project during recent weeks. Our conference is scheduled for March 3. With our advance payment, you agreed to have the work completed one week ②<u>prior</u> to the opening (contract copy enclosed). I question whether you will be able to meet the ③<u>term</u> of the contract, and I am very concerned about ④<u>being</u> ready for the conference. Please call me, and follow up in writing, about how you intend to complete the work on time. If it appears that you will default on this contract, we will take immediate measure to protect ourselves.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ virtually=사실상, ② prior=이전의, ③ terms→term 오류(meet the terms 고정표현), ④ being=동명사
det.analysis:
❌ ① virtually: 부사로 no progress 강조, 적절
❌ ② prior: prior to = ~에 앞서, 전치사구로 적절
✅ ③ term: 원문은 terms. 'meet the terms of the contract'는 관용 표현으로 복수(terms) 고정 ←정답
❌ ④ being: 전치사 about의 목적어로 동명사 being, 적절
det.tip: meet the terms of the contract — '계약 조건(들)을 충족하다': terms는 복수 고정 표현

questions.passage: My brother, Daniel Jones, ②<u>recommended</u> your company as one that would do a good job of building our exhibition booths, but we have seen ③<u>considerably</u> no progress on the project during recent weeks. Our conference is scheduled for March 3. With our advance payment, you agreed to have the work completed one week prior to the opening (contract copy enclosed). I question whether you will be able to meet the terms of the contract, and I am very ④<u>concerned</u> about being ready for the conference. Please call me, and follow up in writing, about how you intend to complete the work on time. If it appears that you will ①<u>default</u> on this contract, we will take immediate measure to protect ourselves.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① recommended=추천했다, ② virtually→considerably 오류(no progress 강조 부사), ③ concerned=걱정하는, ④ default=불이행하다
det.analysis:
❌ ① recommended: 형제가 추천했다, 문맥 적절
✅ ③ considerably: 원문은 virtually(사실상). 'virtually no progress'는 '사실상 아무 진전이 없다'는 의미. considerably(상당히)는 no와 어울리지 않아 문맥 부적절 ←정답
❌ ② concerned: 진행 없는 상황에서 걱정하는 것, 적절
❌ ④ default: default on a contract = 계약 불이행, 적절
det.tip: virtually + no = 사실상 없다. considerably + no는 어색한 표현

questions.passage: My brother, Daniel Jones, recommended your company as one that would do a good job of building our exhibition booths, but we have seen virtually no progress on the project during recent weeks. Our conference is scheduled for March 3. With our ②<u>advance</u> payment, you agreed to have the work completed one week ③<u>prior</u> to the opening (contract copy enclosed). I question whether you will be able to meet the terms of the contract, and I am very concerned about being ready for the conference. Please call me, and follow up in writing, about how you ④<u>intend</u> to complete the work on time. If it appears that you will default on this contract, we will take ①<u>delayed</u> measure to protect ourselves.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① advance=사전의, ② prior=이전의, ③ intend=의도하다, ④ immediate→delayed 오류(즉각 조치가 맥락에 맞음)
det.analysis:
❌ ④ advance: advance payment = 선납금, 문맥 적절
❌ ② prior: prior to the opening = 개막 이전에, 문맥 적절
❌ ③ intend: how you intend to complete = 어떻게 완료할 계획인지, 문맥 적절
✅ ① delayed: 원문은 immediate(즉각적인). 계약 불이행 시 자신을 보호하려면 delayed(지연된) 조치가 아니라 immediate(즉각적인) 조치가 맞음 ←정답
det.tip: 계약 불이행 시 즉각 자구책이 필요. delayed(지연된) 조치는 목적과 반대

questions.stem: 글쓴이의 형제가 이 시공 업체를 소개해 주었다.

det.korean: My brother, Daniel Jones, recommended your company
det.analysis:
✅ T: 'My brother, Daniel Jones, recommended your company' — 형제가 회사를 추천, 일치
❌ F: 부적절
det.tip: recommended = 추천했다. 형제의 이름은 Daniel Jones

questions.passage: My brother, Daniel Jones, recommended your company as one that would do a good job of building our exhibition booths, but we have seen virtually no progress on the project during recent weeks. questions.stem: 회사는 개막 2주일 전까지 작업을 완료하기로 합의했다.

det.korean: one week prior to the opening — 1주일 전이지 2주일 전이 아님
det.analysis:
❌ T: 부적절 — 원문은 'one week prior', 1주일 전
✅ F: 2주일 전이 아니라 개막 1주일 전 완료. 원문과 불일치 ←정답
det.tip: one week prior to the opening = 개막 1주일 전. 2주일 전은 없음

questions.passage: My brother, Daniel Jones, recommended your company as one that would do a good job of building our exhibition booths, but we have seen virtually no progress on the project during recent weeks. questions.stem: 글쓴이는 회사에 전화와 서면 두 가지 방식으로 연락해달라고 요청했다.

det.korean: Please call me, and follow up in writing
det.analysis:
✅ T: 'Please call me, and follow up in writing' — 전화 + 서면 두 방식 요청, 원문 일치
❌ F: 부적절
det.tip: call me(전화) AND follow up in writing(서면) — 둘 다 요청

questions.passage: My brother, Daniel Jones, recommended your company as one that would do a good job of building our exhibition booths, but we have seen virtually no progress on the project during recent weeks. Our conference is scheduled for March 3. With our advance payment, you agreed to have the work completed one week prior to the opening (contract copy enclosed). I question whether you will be able to __________ the terms of the contract, and I am very concerned about being ready for the conference. Please call me, and follow up in writing, about how you intend to complete the work on time. If it appears that you will default on this contract, we will take immediate measure to protect ourselves.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: meet the terms of the contract = 계약 조건을 충족하다
det.analysis:
✅ ① meet: meet the terms = 계약 조건을 충족하다 ←정답
❌ ② question: 의심하다 — 조건을 '의심'한다는 의미로 부적절
❌ ③ follow: 따르다 — follow the terms도 맥락상 가능해 보이나, 'follow the terms'는 비표준 표현
❌ ④ complete: 완료하다 — 조건을 '완료'한다는 의미로 meet과 다름
det.tip: meet the terms = 계약 조건을 충족하다. question/follow/complete는 terms와 어울리지 않음

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: default on a contract = 계약을 불이행하다
det.analysis:
❌ ① deliver: 이행/납품하다 — 의미 반대
✅ ② default: default on this contract = 이 계약을 불이행하다 ←정답
❌ ③ negotiate: 협상하다 — 문맥상 부적절(이미 계약 체결 후 상황)
❌ ④ complete: 완료하다 — 긍정적 의미로 문맥과 반대
det.tip: default on = 불이행하다. deliver/complete는 반의어 관계

questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: advance payment로 선납 후 계약 완료 요청이 원문 일치
det.analysis:
❌ ① 몇 달이 아니라 recent weeks(최근 몇 주)
❌ ② 개막 당일이 아니라 one week prior to the opening(개막 1주일 전)
✅ ③ 원문: 'With our advance payment, you agreed to have the work completed' ←정답
❌ ④ 계약서 사본은 이미 동봉(contract copy enclosed)됨. 요구하는 게 아님
det.tip: advance payment = 선납금 완료. contract copy enclosed = 이미 첨부

ch: 글쓴이는 최근 몇 달 동안 작업 진전이 없었다고 했다.

det.analysis: virtually no progress on the project = 사실상 아무런 진전이 없음. 계약 의심의 직접 근거
det.tip: virtually = 사실상. 6단어 발췌 핵심: 'virtually no progress on the project'

questions.passage: My brother, Daniel Jones, recommended your company as one that would do a good job of building our exhibition booths, but we have seen virtually no progress on the project during recent weeks. Our conference is scheduled for March 3. With our advance payment, you agreed to have the work completed one week prior to the opening (contract copy enclosed). I question whether you will be able to meet the terms of the contract, and I am very concerned about being ready for the conference. Please call me, and follow up in writing, about how you intend to complete the work on time. __________, we will take immediate measure to protect ourselves.
questions.stem:
주어진 단어들을 올바른 순서로 배열하여 빈칸을 완성하시오. (영어로, 10단어) [단어] you / on / default / will / this / contract / that / appears / it / if

appears / contract / default / If / it / on / that / this / will / you

→ __________

det.korean: 만약 귀사가 이 계약을 이행하지 않을 것으로 보인다면
det.analysis: If it appears that you will default on this contract — 조건절 구조
det.tip: It appears that = ~인 것처럼 보이다. If로 시작하는 조건절

questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 전시회 부스 공사 지연 → 계약 이행 촉구 + 불이행 시 즉각 조치
det.analysis:
✅ ① 전시회 부스 공사 지연에 대한 계약 이행 촉구 ←정답
❌ ② 선납금 환불/해지 절차 언급 없음
❌ ③ 추천 요청 아님 (추천은 이미 받은 것)
❌ ④ 일정 변경 아님
det.tip: 핵심: virtually no progress → 이행 촉구 + default 시 immediate measure

ch: 전시회 부스 공사 지연에 대한 계약 이행 촉구
선납금 환불을 위해 계약을 해지하는 절차
신규 건설 업체를 선발하기 위한 추천 요청
행사 일정 변경에 따른 시공 업체 통보

questions.passage: My brother, Daniel Jones, recommended your company as one that would do a good job of building our exhibition booths, but we have seen virtually no progress on the project during recent weeks. Our conference is scheduled for March 3. With our advance payment, you agreed to have the work completed one week prior to the opening (contract copy enclosed). I question whether you will be able to meet the terms of the contract, and I am very concerned about being ready for the conference. Please call me, and follow up in writing, about how you intend to complete the work on time. If it appears that you will default on this contract, we will take immediate measure to protect ourselves.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: advance payment 완료 + no progress → 이행 촉구 + default 시 즉각 조치
det.analysis:
❌ ① 추가 비용 청구 언급 없음
✅ ② 선납금(advance payment) + 공사 진전 없음(virtually no progress) → 이행 요구 ←정답
❌ ③ 추천인 역할의 중요성은 지문의 요지가 아님
❌ ④ 서면 계약 작성 조언이 아닌, 이행 촉구가 요지
det.tip: advance payment(선납) + virtually no progress(지연) = 이행 촉구의 핵심 구조

ch: 계약 이행이 지연될 때는 시공사에 추가 비용을 청구해야 한다.
선납금을 지불했음에도 공사 진전이 없어 계약 이행을 요구하고 있다.
행사 준비에서 업체 선정 시 신뢰할 만한 추천인의 역할이 중요하다.
계약 불이행에 대비해 법적 효력이 있는 서면 계약서 작성이 필요하다.
